# Flooring Maxx

Flooring Maxx is a locally owned and operated certified Mohawk dealer serving Toledo, Ohio and the surrounding area. They specialize in Revwood laminate and SolidTech vinyl plank flooring, backed by installers with at least 10 years of industry experience. Their standout value proposition is a no-pressure, in-home showroom experience where they bring samples directly to the customer, combined with flexible financing options including 12 months no payments and no interest.

## Flooring Solutions for Every Home



As a certified Mohawk dealer, Flooring Maxx brings you two premium flooring lines — Revwood laminate and SolidTech vinyl plank — each engineered for beautiful, lasting performance. We help you compare them side by side during a relaxed, no-pressure in-home visit.












### Revwood Laminate


Authentic wood look with remarkable durability. Revwood combines the warmth of hardwood with a tough, easy-care surface that stands up to daily life.


- Authentic hardwood visuals with natural grain patterns

- Scratch- and stain-resistant for active households

- Easy click-lock installation with minimal subfloor prep

- Simple sweeping and occasional damp-mopping care



Best for: Active homes, living areas, and homeowners who want the look of real wood without the upkeep.











### SolidTech Vinyl Plank


Waterproof resilience meets family-friendly performance. SolidTech delivers stylish plank visuals with a rigid core that handles moisture, pets, and heavy foot traffic effortlessly.


- 100% waterproof core — ideal for kitchens, baths, and basements

- Rigid core construction resists dents and temperature shifts

- Built-in acoustic backing for quieter rooms

- Realistic wood and stone visuals with textured embossing



Best for: Moisture-prone areas, busy families with kids and pets, and whole-home installations.










We bring the showroom to your home — compare Revwood and SolidTech samples in your own lighting, against your own walls, with zero pressure. Our 10+ year installers help you choose the perfect fit.
















## Trusted Local Flooring Expertise


Proudly serving Toledo, Ohio and the surrounding communities with honest advice, premium products, and installation you can count on. We bring the showroom to your home so you can choose the perfect floor without any pressure.











### Locally Owned & Operated


We live and work right here in Toledo. When you choose Flooring Maxx, you're supporting a neighbor who genuinely cares about your home and our community.









### Certified Mohawk Dealer


As a certified Mohawk partner, we offer exclusive access to industry-leading Revwood laminate and SolidTech vinyl plank flooring backed by robust manufacturer warranties.









### 10+ Years of Experience

# Flooring Solutions Tailored for Your Toledo Home


Choosing the right floor doesn't have to be complicated. At Flooring Maxx, we make it simple with a straightforward guide to our most trusted materials — Revwood laminate and SolidTech vinyl plank — backed by decades of local installation experience and a no-pressure, in-home showroom experience.

## Choose the Best Floor for Your Lifestyle & Home


Every Toledo home has unique needs—whether it's heavy foot traffic, curious pets, or moisture-prone basements. Flooring Maxx simplifies the decision with two premium material lines designed for real life, backed by our certified Mohawk expertise and 10+ years of installation experience.










### Revwood Laminate


Experience the authentic look and texture of hardwood without the worry. Revwood laminate delivers realistic wood visuals, exceptional scratch resistance, and everyday durability that stands up to kids, pets, and busy households. It's the perfect flooring solution for active families seeking beauty and resilience.


- Realistic wood grain textures

- Superior scratch & stain resistance

- Easy click-lock installation












### SolidTech Vinyl Plank


Designed for spaces where moisture is a concern, SolidTech vinyl plank flooring offers complete water resistance, cushioned comfort underfoot, and practical maintenance for busy homeowners. Ideal for kitchens, bathrooms, and basements, it combines everyday durability with a soft, quiet feel that laminate and tile can't match.


- 100% waterproof construction

- Comfortable & quiet underfoot

- Simple routine maintenance

## Practical Benefits That Matter for Your Toledo Home



Choosing new flooring is a big decision. We focus on the real-world advantages that make a difference for your family every day — from enduring Ohio seasons to matching your unique style and standing up to busy households.











### Engineered for Lasting Durability


Our Revwood laminate and SolidTech vinyl plank are built to resist scratches, dents, and moisture — ideal for Toledo's changing weather. Backed by Mohawk warranties, your floors stay beautiful for years without constant upkeep.









### Endless Style Flexibility


From rich wood looks to modern stone textures, our Mohawk collections offer authentic visuals that complement any decor. Mix and match styles across rooms for a cohesive, designer-quality feel throughout your home.









### Safe & Family-Friendly Performance


Our flooring is designed with your family in mind — low VOC emissions, easy-to-clean surfaces, and comfortable underfoot. Perfect for kids, pets, and high-traffic areas where safety and hygiene come first.










See it in your space, not on a showroom wall. Our in-home sample visit lets you compare colors against your actual walls, cabinets, and lighting — no guesswork, no pressure. We bring the showroom to you so you can make a confident decision.













## How We Make Flooring Simple


From your first call to the final walkthrough, our process is built around your home, your schedule, and your peace of mind. No pressure, no showroom hassle — just beautiful floors installed by experts with at least a decade of experience.






1



### In-Home Estimate


We bring the showroom to you. Our design consultant visits your home to measure, discuss your vision, and understand your lifestyle — all with zero pressure to commit.







2



### Sample Review & Selection


Touch and compare Revwood laminate and SolidTech vinyl plank samples in your actual lighting. We'll guide you through durability, warranty, and financing so you can choose with confidence.







3



### Professional Installation


Our installers have at least 10 years of industry experience. We handle every detail — furniture moving, old floor removal, and precise installation — treating your home with the respect it deserves.







4



### Final Walkthrough


We walk through the finished space together to ensure every plank and seam meets our standards — and yours. Your satisfaction is the only measure of a job well done.

## Common Questions About Your Flooring Project




### Do you service my area in Toledo?


Yes! Flooring Maxx is locally owned and operated right here in Toledo, Ohio, and we proudly serve the entire surrounding area. We bring our showroom directly to your home, so no matter where you are in the region, you get a personalized, no-pressure experience.

# Privacy Policy



Last Updated:  6/6/2026



Flooring Maxx ("Company", "we", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our website [business_website] ("Service").


## 1. Information Collection


We may collect the following types of information:


- Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number and address

- Technical Information: IP address, browser type, operating system and website usage data

- Cookies: Information stored on your computer to improve user experience




## 2. Use of Information


We use the collected information for the following purposes:


- Providing requested services

- Improving service and user experience

- Contacting you regarding our services

- Compliance with legal requirements




## 3. Information Sharing


We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties, except in the following cases:


- With your explicit consent

- When required by law

- To protect our rights or user safety

- With service providers who assist in operating the service (under confidentiality agreements)




## 4. User Rights


In accordance with Israeli Privacy Protection Law 1981, you have the following rights:


- Right to access personal information stored about you

- Right to correct inaccurate or incomplete information

- Right to delete personal information in certain circumstances

- Right to object to information processing for marketing purposes

- Right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Authority




## 5. Cookies


Our website uses cookies to improve user experience. You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.


## 6. Information Security


We implement reasonable security measures to protect your information, including encryption, firewalls and restricted access control. However, no transmission or storage method is 100% secure.


## 7. Policy Changes


We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on the website with 30 days advance notice.



## 8. Contact Information


For questions or requests regarding this privacy policy, please contact us:


- Company: Flooring Maxx

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]

- Address: [business_address]



Data Protection Authority: For complaints, you may contact the Data Protection Authority at the Ministry of Justice

# Accessibility Statement



Last updated:  June 6, 2026



Flooring Maxx is committed to making our services accessible to all users. We strive to implement the Israeli Standard (TI 5568) based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.


Accessibility Level: AA (Israeli Standard TI 5568)



## 1. Accessibility Policy


We believe in equal rights and the right of every person to receive information and services independently and equally. This website was designed and built with special emphasis on accessibility for people with disabilities.


## 2. Accessibility Arrangements on the Site


- Keyboard navigation support

- Screen reader compatibility

- Appropriate color contrast

- Flexible and scalable font sizes

- Descriptive image alt text

- Hierarchical heading structure

- Clear and descriptive links

- Support for 200% zoom without content loss





### WCAG 2.1 Compliance


The website complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, which includes:


- Perceivable: Information is presented in ways users can perceive

- Operable: Interface components are operable

- Understandable: Information and user interface are understandable

- Robust: Content can be interpreted by a variety of technologies





## 3. Supported Assistive Technologies


- NVDA (Windows)

- JAWS (Windows)

- VoiceOver (Mac/iOS)

- TalkBack (Android)

- Dragon NaturallySpeaking

- Switch navigation




## 4. Accessibility Testing


The website has been tested using:


- Automated accessibility testing tools

- Manual testing with screen readers

- Keyboard-only navigation

- Color contrast verification

- Testing with users with disabilities




## 5. Continuous Improvements


We are continuously working to improve the accessibility of our website and update it according to technological developments and user feedback.



## 6. Contact and Feedback


If you encounter an accessibility issue on the site or need assistance, please contact us:


- Company: Flooring Maxx

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]



Response time: We respond to accessibility inquiries within 3 business days and work to resolve issues within 10 business days.
